card_title: Artist Notes: Glow Catalyst Lip Stain
description: Offered at $24.0 for 4ml, this KoColor STAIN is expertly formulated with Water, Octyldodecanol, Trimethylsiloxyphenyl Dimethicone, Ethylcellulose, Red 28 Lake, Yellow 6 Lake. Delivering a high-fidelity Crimson Catalyst color profile (`#A81C28`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
